articles.summary: Mike Cottonaro will retire after 38 years of dedicated service and leadership with the company’s mattress fabrics division.
articles.title: Culp Announces Planned Retirement of Mike Cottonaro, Senior Vice President of Sales and Marketing for Culp Home Fashions

articles.summary: Pat Rosser worked for Culp Home Fashions from 2011 to 2014 as Director of Operations, and served as the division’s VP of Operations from 2014 to 2020.
articles.title: Pat Rosser Joins Culp as Vice President of Global Operations for Culp Home Fashions
